name: Gets a list of bank_transactions
whenToUse: List or filter many bank transactions with paging and sorting; use to browse, search, or find transactions when you lack a specific id.

queryParameters.name: include
queryParameters.description: Includes child relationships in the response, format is comma separated. Check each model for the list of associated includes

queryParameters.name: index
queryParameters.description:
Replaces the default response index from data to a user specific string

ie.

```html
  ?index=new_index
```

response is wrapped

```json
  {
    'new_index' : [
      .....
    ]
  }
```

queryParameters.name: rows
queryParameters.description: The number of bank integrations to return

queryParameters.name: per_page
queryParameters.description: The number of records to return for each request, default is 20

queryParameters.name: page
queryParameters.description: The page number to return for this request (when performing pagination), default is 1

queryParameters.name: sort
queryParameters.description:
Order the list by choosing a column and direction. Each value uses the form `column|asc` or `column|desc`.

*Single sort** — for example `sort=date|desc`.

*Multiple sorts** — for example
`sort[]=amount|asc&sort[]=date|desc`.

Bank transactions accept columns and relationship sorts exposed by `BankTransactionFilters`. Unsupported keys are ignored.
